A shop sells only one type of office chair.
The shop buys these chairs from a maker.
In one year the shop buys 600 of these chairs.

parts.label: a
parts.text:
Buying cost
It costs the shop $240 to buy one of these chairs from the maker.
This is the buying cost for one chair.
Find the total buying cost for the 600 chairs.
............................................................. [2]

parts.label: b
parts.text:
Because of lack of space and money the shop cannot buy all the 600 chairs at once.
Instead, it buys x chairs at a time.
This is called an order for x chairs.
Write down an expression for the number of orders the shop makes in one year.
............................................................. [1]

parts.label: c
parts.text:
Ordering cost
For each order there is a cost, called the ordering cost.
This is for filling in forms and checking the delivery.
The shop has an ordering cost of $32 for each order.
Use your answer to 5(b) to find an expression for the total ordering cost in one year.
Write your answer as a single fraction.
............................................................. [2]

The shop estimates that the number of chairs that it stores at any time is the mean of 0 and x.
